method: code-placed primitives in Blender 5.2 (bpy module) with procedural tileable numpy surfaces; Cycles CPU bake of colour x AO into one 1024 px JPEG atlas per building; flat Principled BSDF (roughness 0.82, no metallic); GLB export with the atlas embedded (Godot extracts it to <id>_<id>_albedo.jpg on import)
tools: Blender 5.2 (bpy), numpy, Pillow - no AI image generation, no external textures or scans
content_notes: Generic Middle-East / Mediterranean town style. No real-world logos, brands, writing or flags (flagpole is bare; sign boards carry abstract shapes only). Hospital is marked only with a plain white 'H' on green panels and a white 'H' in a circle on the helipad; no red cross, red crescent, red crystal or other protected emblem.
conventions: 1 unit = 1 m; origin = footprint centre at ground level; main entrance faces Godot +Z (Blender -Y), same as the existing structures and props; walls extend 0.5 m below ground. Nodes: mesh '<id>', empties 'Door', 'Port1'..'PortN', and 'Heal' (hospital only).

items.description: Single-storey sand-plaster house: flat roof with a low parapet, teal door under a hood, four windows (green shutters / bars), black and white roof water tanks, front terrace
Two-storey beige house: front balcony with a metal railing and awning, roof stair hut with tanks, solar water heater and dish, walled courtyard on the east side with a gate and a tree
Four-storey apartment block: ground-floor shops with roller shutters and blank colour fascias, two balconies per floor, wall AC units, rooftop stair hut, tank rack, solar heaters, dishes and antenna

Two-storey community centre: stone-clad ground floor, glazed entrance bay with a canopy on columns, bare flagpole (no flag), monument and fascia sign boards with abstract shapes only, paved forecourt with planters and benches

Three-storey hospital: ribbon windows, glazed lobby behind an ambulance-bay canopy and drive, white 'H' on green sign panels (canopy, pylon, stair core), rooftop plant room and helipad with a white 'H' in a circle

icons.method: Cycles CPU render of each exported GLB: front-3/4 perspective camera (az -35, el 30, 40 deg vertical FOV) fitted so the above-ground building fills 85% of the frame, soft sun (12 deg) + sky fill, shadow-catcher ground, composited on plain neutral grey RGB(64,66,68), rendered at 3x and LANCZOS-downsampled
